items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: when Mozart was creating, I’m sure he wasn’t thinking.

ctx.x: Sonny Rollins did an interview and he was talking about music being spiritual. He says, “Listen, the music comes to me, I don’t know where it’s coming from, I don’t. I’m just the vessel for it.” So I use the word aesthetic mind. Above the analytical mind, which is great for practice, great for reasoning, what you use in the mathematics let’s say. There’s the aesthetic mind. And that operates in a different way than the analytical mind. And that level of mind is the mind for creation. It’s a higher level mind. It…
